title: receipt (widget tool input)
description: What the agent sends to the widget tool: the payload without id, rev and producer (the tool sets them); fallback_text optional (the tool writes it); from_file allowed. Proof that something was done: what, the key facts, the confirmation, and Undo while it’s still possible.

allOf.description: An undone receipt has no Undo: the agent removes `undo` when it sets `undone`.

headline.description: What was done, verb and object in the past tense: “Lunch ordered”, “Table for 4 booked”, “Post scheduled”.

detail.description: One line under the headline: when it arrives, when it goes out, where it is.

label.description: What the fact is: From, Paid, Order, Arrives, Seats.

detail.description: After the value, joined with ·: “Visa •• 4242”. Masked, never a full card or account number.

copy.description: A reference worth copying (an order or booking number): set in mono with a Copy glyph. Copying is local.

items.description: One key fact of what was done. Text facts use `format: text`; an unknown value is null (shown as —), never guessed.

facts.description: The key facts, in reading order: who it’s from, what was paid and how, the reference, when.

label.description: The line beside the Undo button: “You can cancel until 11:40 AM”, “You can unschedule it until it goes out”.

note.description: What undoing does when it isn’t a clean reversal: “A $2 cancellation fee applies”. When set, Undo asks before sending, with this line.

undo.description: Undo while it’s possible. The button is always “Undo” and sends the built-in `undo` action. Set `until` whenever the provider gives a time; the client hides Undo at that moment by itself.

headline.description: What was reversed, past tense: “Order cancelled”, “Post unscheduled”.

detail.description: One line: what comes back and when: “$14.50 refunded to Visa •• 4242 in 3–5 days”.

refund.description: Money that comes back, when any. Builds the detail line when `detail` is omitted.

undone.description: Set by the agent’s update after a confirmed undo. Replaces the hero; the facts and the Undo bar go.

note.description: A quiet last line when there is no Undo and it matters why: “Non-refundable”, “Tickets are in Wallet”.

confirmation.description: How the agent knows it’s done: the provider’s confirmation (an order number in an API response, a confirmation email, the booking page, the sent message). Required: a receipt is only sent after the outcome is confirmed. A `claim` (someone said so) is not enough and fails validation; say it in prose or use `steps` with the step pending.
